statements.text: The purpose of this document is to outline the Human Resources operational procedures for the Office of Human Resources at Crestwood University.
statements.quote: The purpose of this document is to outline the Human Resources operational procedures for the Office of Human Resources at Crestwood University.

statements.text: This SOP covers the end-to-end processes for employee onboarding, offboarding, leave management, performance management, and recruiting.
statements.quote: This SOP covers the end-to-end processes for employee onboarding, offboarding, leave management, performance management, and recruiting.

statements.text: Do not deviate from the procedures described in this document.
statements.quote: Do not deviate from the procedures described in this document.

statements.text: If a situation arises that is not covered, escalate to the HR Director immediately by posting a notification in Slack [OUT OF SCOPE] – [email subject line].
statements.quote: If a situation arises that is not covered, escalate to the HR Director immediately by posting a notification in Slack [OUT OF SCOPE] – [email subject line].

statements.text: The HR Coordinator's role is administrative and digital – process cases using email, Slack, calendar, Jira, and the reference spreadsheets and document templates listed in Section 6.
statements.quote: The HR Coordinator's role is administrative and digital – process cases using email, Slack, calendar, Jira, and the reference spreadsheets and document templates listed in Section 6.

statements.text: Physical tasks — such as conducting in-person orientation sessions, collecting physical documents, or issuing badges — are performed by the hiring manager or the employee's supervisor.
statements.quote: Physical tasks — such as conducting in-person orientation sessions, collecting physical documents, or issuing badges — are performed by the hiring manager or the employee's supervisor.

statements.text: This role is to coordinate, track, and ensure compliance deadlines are met.
statements.quote: This role is to coordinate, track, and ensure compliance deadlines are met.

statements.text: Crestwood University is a private university with approximately 1,400 employees, including full-time staff, part-time staff, and faculty, across three campuses in Colorado (Main Campus in Ridgefield, West Campus in Lakewood, and the Downtown Center in Denver).
statements.quote: Crestwood University is a private university with approximately 1,400 employees, including full-time staff, part-time staff, and faculty, across three campuses in Colorado (Main Campus in Ridgefield, West Campus in Lakewood, and the Downtown Center in Denver).

statements.text: The university employs approximately 620 full-time staff, 280 part-time staff, and 500 faculty members.
statements.quote: The university employs approximately 620 full-time staff, 280 part-time staff, and 500 faculty members.

statements.text: Crestwood operates on a fiscal year of July 1 through June 30 and an academic calendar of fall and spring semesters with a summer session.
statements.quote: Crestwood operates on a fiscal year of July 1 through June 30 and an academic calendar of fall and spring semesters with a summer session.

statements.text: The following terms are used throughout this SOP.
statements.quote: The following terms are used throughout this SOP.

statements.text: All staff must be familiar with these definitions before processing any HR case.
statements.quote: All staff must be familiar with these definitions before processing any HR case.

statements.text: FMLA | Family and Medical Leave Act. Federal law entitling eligible employees to up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave per year.
statements.quote: FMLA | Family and Medical Leave Act. Federal law entitling eligible employees to up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave per year.

statements.text: ADA | Americans with Disabilities Act. Federal law requiring employers to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified employees with disabilities.
statements.quote: ADA | Americans with Disabilities Act. Federal law requiring employers to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified employees with disabilities.

statements.text: COBRA | Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act. Federal law requiring employers to offer continuation of group health coverage after a qualifying event.
statements.quote: COBRA | Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act. Federal law requiring employers to offer continuation of group health coverage after a qualifying event.

statements.text: PIP | Performance Improvement Plan. A formal, documented plan to address and correct employee performance deficiencies.
statements.quote: PIP | Performance Improvement Plan. A formal, documented plan to address and correct employee performance deficiencies.

statements.text: I-9 | Employment Eligibility Verification form. Federal form required within 3 business days of an employee's first day of work.
statements.quote: I-9 | Employment Eligibility Verification form. Federal form required within 3 business days of an employee's first day of work.

statements.text: PTO | Paid Time Off. Combined vacation and personal leave accrued by eligible employees.
statements.quote: PTO | Paid Time Off. Combined vacation and personal leave accrued by eligible employees.

statements.text: Qualifying Event | A life event (marriage, birth, divorce, loss of other coverage) that triggers eligibility for mid-year benefits enrollment changes or COBRA coverage.
statements.quote: Qualifying Event | A life event (marriage, birth, divorce, loss of other coverage) that triggers eligibility for mid-year benefits enrollment changes or COBRA coverage.

statements.text: Exempt Employee | An employee exempt from overtime provisions of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), typically salaried.
statements.quote: Exempt Employee | An employee exempt from overtime provisions of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), typically salaried.

statements.text: Non-Exempt Employee | An employee entitled to overtime pay under the FLSA, typically hourly.
statements.quote: Non-Exempt Employee | An employee entitled to overtime pay under the FLSA, typically hourly.

statements.text: Probationary Period | The first 90 calendar days of employment for staff, or the first academic year for faculty.
statements.quote: Probationary Period | The first 90 calendar days of employment for staff, or the first academic year for faculty.

statements.text: Supervisor of Record | The direct supervisor listed in employee_roster.xlsx for a given employee.
statements.quote: Supervisor of Record | The direct supervisor listed in employee_roster.xlsx for a given employee.

statements.text: Benefits Enrollment Window | The first 30 calendar days from an employee's start date during which the employee must enroll in or waive benefits.
statements.quote: Benefits Enrollment Window | The first 30 calendar days from an employee's start date during which the employee must enroll in or waive benefits.

statements.text: FMLA Leave Requests
statements.quote: FMLA Leave Requests

statements.text: FMLA entitles eligible employees to up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave in a 12-month period.
statements.quote: FMLA entitles eligible employees to up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave in a 12-month period.

statements.text: Eligibility requires that the employee has been employed by Crestwood University for at least 12 months AND has worked at least 1,250 hours in the 12 months preceding the leave request.
statements.quote: Eligibility requires that the employee has been employed by Crestwood University for at least 12 months AND has worked at least 1,250 hours in the 12 months preceding the leave request.

statements.text: Receiving the Request:
statements.quote: Receiving the Request:

statements.text: Step 1: Open employee_roster.xlsx and confirm the employee's hire date.
statements.quote: Step 1: Open employee_roster.xlsx and confirm the employee's hire date.

statements.text: Calculate the number of months between the hire date and today's date.
statements.quote: Calculate the number of months between the hire date and today's date.

statements.text: If fewer than 12 months, the employee is INELIGIBLE (skip to the ineligible steps below).
statements.quote: If fewer than 12 months, the employee is INELIGIBLE (skip to the ineligible steps below).

statements.text: Step 2: In employee_roster.xlsx, locate the 'Hours Worked (Trailing 12 Months)' column for the employee.
statements.quote: Step 2: In employee_roster.xlsx, locate the 'Hours Worked (Trailing 12 Months)' column for the employee.

statements.text: If the value is less than 1,250, the employee is INELIGIBLE.
statements.quote: If the value is less than 1,250, the employee is INELIGIBLE.

statements.text: Step 3: If BOTH conditions are met (12+ months employed AND 1,250+ hours), the employee is ELIGIBLE.
statements.quote: Step 3: If BOTH conditions are met (12+ months employed AND 1,250+ hours), the employee is ELIGIBLE.

statements.text: If ELIGIBLE:
statements.quote: If ELIGIBLE:

statements.text: Step 4: Send Template 15 (FMLA Eligibility Notice – Approved) to the employee within 5 business days of receiving the request.
statements.quote: Step 4: Send Template 15 (FMLA Eligibility Notice – Approved) to the employee within 5 business days of receiving the request.

statements.text: The employee has 15 calendar days to return the completed medical certification.
statements.quote: The employee has 15 calendar days to return the completed medical certification.

statements.text: Step 5: Create a Jira ticket: LEAVE-[Last Name]-[Date request received MMDDYYYY].
statements.quote: Step 5: Create a Jira ticket: LEAVE-[Last Name]-[Date request received MMDDYYYY].

statements.text: Step 6: Post to #hr-leave-requests: FMLA REQUEST: [Employee Name], [Employee ID], Eligible: YES, Certification Due: [MM/DD/YYYY], Jira: [Ticket ID]
statements.quote: Step 6: Post to #hr-leave-requests: FMLA REQUEST: [Employee Name], [Employee ID], Eligible: YES, Certification Due: [MM/DD/YYYY], Jira: [Ticket ID]

statements.quote: Step 7: Create a Calendar reminder titled "FMLA Certification Due – [Employee Name]" on the certification deadline date.

statements.quote: Step 8: When the medical certification is received, forward to p.huang@crestwood.edu for review.

statements.quote: Update leave_tracker.xlsx with the leave dates and status "Approved – Pending Certification Review."

statements.quote: Step 9: After Patricia approves the certification, update leave_tracker.xlsx status to "Approved." Send Template 16 (FMLA Leave Confirmed) to the employee.

statements.quote: CC the supervisor of record.

procedures.name: Receiving the New Hire Notification

steps.text: Step 1: Open employee_roster.xlsx and add a new row with all provided details.
Enter the hire date and set the status to "Onboarding."

Step 6: Send Template 5 (IT Access Provisioning Request) to j.park@crestwood.edu. Include: employee name, position, department, campus, start date, and supervisor name.

steps.text: Before Start Date: The HR Coordinator emails the employee the fillable i9_form.pdf with instructions to complete Section 1 (fields: Last Name, First Name, Middle Initial, Other Last Names Used, Address, Date of Birth, SSN, Email, Phone, Citizenship/Immigration Status, and Signature/Date) and bring it along with original identity documents to their first day.

Update the Jira ticket.

Send a follow-up to the hiring manager.
Post to #hr-escalations: I-9 OVERDUE: [Employee Name], [Employee ID], Start Date: [MM/DD/YYYY], Deadline: [MM/DD/YYYY] – Section 2 not received.
Forward to n.ashford@crestwood.edu.
After Day 3 (deadline passed without completion): Forward to n.ashford@crestwood.edu and j.whitfield@crestwood.edu.
Send Template 7 to the hiring manager notifying them the employee may not continue working until the I-9 is completed.
Post to #hr-escalations.

procedures.name: Benefits Enrollment

steps.text: Record "Packet Provided" and the date in onboarding_checklist.xlsx.
Day 15: If benefits_enrollment.xlsx does not show an enrollment or waiver for the employee, send Template 8 (Benefits Enrollment Reminder) to the employee.
Log the reminder date in onboarding_checklist.xlsx.
Day 25: If still no enrollment or waiver, send Template 9 (Final Benefits Notice) to the employee. CC Patricia Huang.
Log in onboarding_checklist.xlsx.
Update benefits_enrollment.xlsx with "Default Enrollment" and the date.
Send Template 10 to the employee confirming default enrollment.

deadlines: 30 calendar days from their start date to enroll in or waive benefits
If the 30th day falls on a weekend or holiday, the deadline extends to the next business day.
notes: Default enrollment effective date rule: The effective date for default enrollment is the first day of the month following the end of the 30-day enrollment window.
For example, if the employee's start date is 03/10/2026, the 30-day window ends 04/09/2026, and the default enrollment effective date is 05/01/2026.

procedures.name: FMLA Leave Requests

steps.text: Step 1: Open employee_roster.xlsx and confirm the employee's hire date.
Calculate the number of months between the hire date and today's date.
If fewer than 12 months, the employee is INELIGIBLE (skip to the ineligible steps below).
Step 2: In employee_roster.xlsx, locate the 'Hours Worked (Trailing 12 Months)' column for the employee.
If the value is less than 1,250, the employee is INELIGIBLE.
Step 3: If BOTH conditions are met (12+ months employed AND 1,250+ hours), the employee is ELIGIBLE.
Step 4: Send Template 15 (FMLA Eligibility Notice – Approved) to the employee within 5 business days of receiving the request.
Step 5: Create a Jira ticket: LEAVE-[Last Name]-[Date request received MMDDYYYY].
Step 6: Post to #hr-leave-requests: FMLA REQUEST: [Employee Name], [Employee ID], Eligible: YES, Certification Due: [MM/DD/YYYY], Jira: [Ticket ID]
Step 7: Create a Calendar reminder titled "FMLA Certification Due – [Employee Name]" on the certification deadline date.

steps.condition: When the medical certification is received
steps.text: Step 8: When the medical certification is received, forward to p.huang@crestwood.edu for review.

steps.condition: When the medical certification is received
steps.text: Update leave_tracker.xlsx with the leave dates and status "Approved – Pending Certification Review."
Step 9: After Patricia approves the certification, update leave_tracker.xlsx status to "Approved." Send Template 16 (FMLA Leave Confirmed) to the employee. CC the supervisor of record.

Step 4: Send Template 17 (FMLA Eligibility Notice – Denied) to the employee within 5 business days. Specify the reason: "employed for fewer than 12 months," "fewer than 1,250 hours worked in the preceding 12 months," or "both." CC Patricia Huang.
Step 5: Create a Jira ticket: LEAVE-[Last Name]-[Date request received MMDDYYYY].
Update leave_tracker.xlsx with the request date and status "Denied – [Reason]."

steps.condition: If the employee does not return the medical certification within 15 calendar days
steps.text: Send Template 18 (FMLA Certification Overdue) to the employee.

steps.condition: If the employee does not return the medical certification within 15 calendar days

steps.text: Forward to p.huang@crestwood.edu.

procedures.name: Job Posting

steps.text: All positions must be posted for a minimum of 10 business days.
Step 1: Draft the posting using job_posting_template.docx.

Include: position title, department, campus, reporting supervisor, classification (exempt/non-exempt), salary range, minimum qualifications, preferred qualifications, application deadline, and the instruction for applicants to submit materials to applications@crestwood.edu.
Step 2: Send the completed draft to d.okonkwo@crestwood.edu for review and approval.
Step 3: Once approved, email the finalized posting (as a PDF attachment) to d.okonkwo@crestwood.edu.
Update recruiting_tracker.xlsx status to "Posted." Record the posting date and application deadline.
Step 4: Create a Calendar event titled "Posting Closes – [Position Title]" on the application deadline date.

procedures.name: Interview Scheduling

steps.text: Step 1: Once the hiring manager selects candidates for interview, email the hiring manager and any search committee members asking them to provide their available date/time blocks for interviews within the next 10 business days. Use Template 32.

Step 2: Once the hiring manager replies with availability, email each selected candidate using Template 33 (Interview Availability Request), listing the available date/time options and asking the candidate to reply with their preferred slot by a specified deadline (3 business days from the email).
Step 3: Once candidates respond, assign each candidate to a slot.

steps.condition: If multiple candidates select the same slot
steps.text: If multiple candidates select the same slot, assign it to the candidate who responded first and email the other candidate(s) with the remaining options.
Step 4: Send Template 29 (Interview Invitation) to each selected candidate with the date, time, location, format (in-person or virtual), and estimated duration.
Step 5: Create Calendar events titled "Interview – [Candidate Name] – [Position Title]" for each interview. Invite all participants.
Step 6: Update recruiting_tracker.xlsx with interview dates and candidate status "Interview Scheduled."

procedures.name: Email Housekeeping

steps.text: Mark as read | Every processed email must be marked as read, without exception.
P1 / P2 emails | Leave in Inbox. Flag as important. Do NOT move to a folder until the case is fully resolved. Once resolved, keep the flag and move to the appropriate topic folder.

Any legal threat, reference to an attorney, or mention of a regulatory complaint.
Any situation involving potential harm to an employee or to the university.
Any media inquiry related to HR matters.
For legal threats: Do NOT reply to the email.
Post to #hr-escalations: LEGAL THREAT: [Employee Name], [Subject Line] – do not reply.
Forward to hr-escalations@crestwood.edu.
Dr. Whitfield and Nicole Ashford will handle all further communication.
For media inquiries: Do NOT reply.
Forward to the university's Office of Communications at communications@crestwood.edu and to hr-escalations@crestwood.edu.
must_not: For legal threats: Do NOT reply to the email.
For media inquiries: Do NOT reply.

priority.name: Priority Matrix
levels: P1 – Urgent | Compliance deadline within 24 hours; legal or safety issue; employee locked out of pay or benefits. | I-9 deadline expiring today; COBRA 14-day notice window closing; employee reports workplace safety threat. | Same business day

P2 – High | Compliance deadline within 3 business days; formal complaint; FMLA eligibility determination; PIP-related termination in progress. | I-9 due within 3 days; FMLA medical certification deadline; formal written complaint requesting escalation. | 1 business day

P3 – Standard | Routine processing with no imminent deadline; standard onboarding/offboarding; evaluation scheduling; PTO balance inquiries. | New hire onboarding (start date > 3 days away); annual evaluation scheduling; standard resignation processing. | 3 business days

P4 – Low | General inquiries; employment verification; policy questions; document requests. | Employee asking about PTO policy; request for copy of offer letter; general benefits question answered by handbook. | 5 business days

Leave Management.Date to Use in Ticket Name: Date the leave request was received by HR

Performance Management.Date to Use in Ticket Name: Date the action was initiated (e.g., PIP start date, evaluation due date)

Employee Relations.Date to Use in Ticket Name: Date the complaint was received by HR

Benefits & Payroll.Date to Use in Ticket Name: Date the request was received by HR

1.name: Unrecognized Requester
1.text: Hi [First Name], Thank you for reaching out to the Crestwood University Office of Human Resources. We were unable to locate your information in our records. If you are a current employee, please reply with your Employee ID and department so we can assist you. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

2.name: Employee Relations Referral
2.text: Hi [First Name], Thank you for contacting us. Your message has been forwarded to our Employee Relations Specialist, who will follow up with you directly. Please allow 2 business days for initial contact. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

3.name: Payroll Referral
3.text: Hi [First Name], Thank you for reaching out. For all payroll and compensation questions, please contact our Payroll Liaison, Calvin Briggs, directly at c.briggs@crestwood.edu. Your message has been forwarded to him. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

4.name: New Hire Welcome
4.text: Hi [First Name], Welcome to Crestwood University! We are excited to have you join us as [Position Title] in the [Department] department at our [Campus] campus. Your first day is [Start Date]. Your supervisor, [Supervisor Name], will conduct your orientation session beginning at 9:00am MST. Please bring the following: Two forms of identification for I-9 verification (see acceptable documents list attached) Voided check or bank routing information for direct deposit setup Attached to this email is the I-9 form (i9_form.pdf). Please complete Section 1 of the form before your first day and bring it with you along with your original identity documents. If you have any questions before your first day, please do not hesitate to reach out. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

5.name: IT Access Provisioning Request
5.text: Hi Jenna, Please provision the following IT access for a new employee: Name: [Employee Name] Position: [Position Title] Department: [Department] Campus: [Campus] Start Date: [Start Date] Supervisor: [Supervisor Name] Please have credentials ready by [Start Date]. Thank you. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

6.name: I-9 Urgent Reminder
6.text: Hi [Hiring Manager First Name], This is an urgent reminder regarding the I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification for [Employee Name] ([Employee ID]). The federal deadline for completing Section 2 of the I-9 is [Deadline Date]. We have not yet received the completed form. Please examine the employee's original identity and work authorization documents, complete Section 2 of the I-9, and email the scanned signed form to hr@crestwood.edu as soon as possible. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

7.name: I-9 Deadline Passed – Supervisor Notification
7.text: Hi [Supervisor First Name], This is to inform you that the I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification for [Employee Name] ([Employee ID]) has not been completed by the federal deadline. [Employee Name] may not continue working until this requirement is fulfilled. Please do not assign work to this employee until further notice from the HR Office. This matter has been escalated to the HR Director. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

8.name: Benefits Enrollment Reminder (Day 15)
8.text: Hi [First Name], This is a reminder that your benefits enrollment deadline is [Deadline Date] (30 calendar days from your start date). We have not yet received your enrollment selections or benefits waiver. Please complete your enrollment at your earliest convenience. If you have questions about your options, contact Patricia Huang at p.huang@crestwood.edu. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

9.name: Benefits Final Notice (Day 25)
9.text: Hi [First Name], This is a final notice that your benefits enrollment deadline is [Deadline Date]. If we do not receive your enrollment selections or a signed benefits waiver by this date, you will be automatically enrolled in the university's default health plan. Please contact Patricia Huang at p.huang@crestwood.edu immediately if you need assistance. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

10.name: Default Benefits Enrollment Confirmation
10.text: Hi [First Name], As your benefits enrollment deadline of [Deadline Date] has passed without a completed enrollment or waiver, you have been automatically enrolled in Crestwood University's default health plan effective [Effective Date]. If you have questions or believe this is in error, please contact Patricia Huang at p.huang@crestwood.edu. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

11.name: COBRA Notification
slots: separation of employment / reduction in hours
11.text: Hi [First Name], This notice is to inform you that your group health coverage through Crestwood University will end on [Coverage End Date] due to [separation of employment / reduction in hours]. Under the Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA), you may be eligible to continue your current health coverage for up to 18 months at your own expense. The COBRA election form and instructions will be mailed to your address on file within 5 business days. You have 60 calendar days from the date you receive the form to elect COBRA continuation coverage. If you have questions, please contact Patricia Huang at p.huang@crestwood.edu. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

12.name: Final Pay Request to Payroll
slots: if involuntary: final pay is due immediately upon termination / if voluntary: final pay is due on the next regular payday
12.text: Hi Calvin, Please process final pay for the following separating employee: Name: [Employee Name] Employee ID: [Employee ID] Last Day of Work: [Date] Separation Type: [Voluntary Resignation / Involuntary Termination / Retirement] Accrued PTO Balance: [X] hours (per leave_tracker.xlsx) Per Colorado law, [if involuntary: final pay is due immediately upon termination / if voluntary: final pay is due on the next regular payday]. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

13.name: Access Revocation Request
slots: End of business on last day / Immediately
13.text: Hi Jenna, Please revoke all system access for the following employee: Name: [Employee Name] Employee ID: [Employee ID] Last Day of Work: [Date] Timing: [End of business on last day / Immediately] This includes email, VPN, building access, and all university systems. Please confirm when complete. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

14.name: Exit Interview Invitation
14.text: Hi [First Name], As part of our offboarding process, we would like to offer you the opportunity to participate in an exit interview. This is completely voluntary and confidential. Your feedback helps us improve the employee experience at Crestwood University. If you are interested, please reply with your availability and we will schedule a 30-minute meeting before your last day of [Last Day]. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

15.name: FMLA Eligibility Notice – Approved
15.text: Hi [First Name], We have reviewed your request for leave under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA). Based on our records, you meet the eligibility requirements (employed for [X] months; [X] hours worked in the preceding 12 months). To proceed, please complete and return the Medical Certification Form (mailed to you separately) within 15 calendar days of this notice (due by [Due Date]). Failure to return the certification by this date may result in denial of your FMLA leave request. If you have questions, please contact Patricia Huang at p.huang@crestwood.edu. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

16.name: FMLA Leave Confirmed
16.text: Hi [First Name], Your FMLA leave has been approved. Your leave details are as follows: Leave Start Date: [Date] Expected Return Date: [Date] Leave Duration: [X] weeks Please note that a fitness-for-duty certification from your healthcare provider will be required before you can return to work. Please contact us at least 5 business days before your intended return date. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

17.name: FMLA Eligibility Notice – Denied
slots: employed for fewer than 12 months / fewer than 1,250 hours worked in the preceding 12 months / both
17.text: Hi [First Name], We have reviewed your request for leave under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA). Unfortunately, you do not meet the eligibility requirements at this time. The reason for ineligibility is: [employed for fewer than 12 months / fewer than 1,250 hours worked in the preceding 12 months / both]. You may be eligible for other types of leave. Please contact Patricia Huang at p.huang@crestwood.edu to discuss your options. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

18.name: FMLA Certification Overdue
18.text: Hi [First Name], This is a reminder that your FMLA Medical Certification Form was due on [Due Date] and has not been received. Your FMLA leave request cannot be processed without this documentation. Please return the completed form as soon as possible. If you need an extension, please contact Patricia Huang at p.huang@crestwood.edu immediately. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

19.name: ADA Accommodation Request Acknowledged
19.text: Hi [First Name], Thank you for submitting your request for a workplace accommodation. Your request has been received and forwarded to our Benefits & Leave Manager, who will coordinate the interactive process with you. You can expect to be contacted within 5 business days to discuss your request and next steps. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

20.name: PTO Balance Response
20.text: Hi [First Name], Your current PTO balance as of [Date] is [X] hours. Your accrual rate is [X] hours per pay period. If you have questions about your balance or accrual rate, please contact Patricia Huang at p.huang@crestwood.edu. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

21.name: Return-to-Work Requirements
21.text: Hi [First Name], Thank you for notifying us of your intended return date of [Date]. Before you may return to work, we require a fitness-for-duty certification from your healthcare provider confirming that you are able to perform the essential functions of your position. Please submit this documentation to hr@crestwood.edu at least 2 business days before your intended return date. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

22.name: Return-to-Work Clearance – Supervisor Notification
22.text: Hi [Supervisor First Name], [Employee Name] ([Employee ID]) has been cleared to return to work effective [Return Date]. Please coordinate their return schedule directly. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

23.name: Annual Evaluation Cycle Reminder
23.text: Hi [Supervisor First Name], This is a reminder that annual performance evaluations for fiscal year [Year] are due by June 30, [Year]. The following employees on your team are due for evaluation: [List of employee names] Please complete and submit evaluations to hr@crestwood.edu by the deadline. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

24.text: Hi [Supervisor First Name], This is a follow-up regarding outstanding annual evaluations due by June 30, [Year]. The following evaluations have not yet been received: [List of employee names] Please submit as soon as possible. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

25.name: Final Evaluation Reminder (June 15)

The following evaluations are due by June 30, [Year] and have not been received: [List of employee names] Failure to complete evaluations by the deadline will be noted in your own performance record. Best regards, Crestwood University – Office of Human Resources hr@crestwood.edu

26.name: Probationary Review Reminder (Day 60)

27.name: Requisition – Missing Signatures

31.text: Hi [Hiring Manager First Name], [Employee Name] is scheduled to begin as [Position Title] on [Start Date]. As the hiring manager, please conduct the in-person orientation on their first day. definitions.meaning: Family and Medical Leave Act. Federal law entitling eligible employees to up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave per year.
Americans with Disabilities Act. Federal law requiring employers to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified employees with disabilities.
Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act. Federal law requiring employers to offer continuation of group health coverage after a qualifying event.
Performance Improvement Plan. A formal, documented plan to address and correct employee performance deficiencies.
Employment Eligibility Verification form. Federal form required within 3 business days of an employee's first day of work.
Paid Time Off. Combined vacation and personal leave accrued by eligible employees.
A life event (marriage, birth, divorce, loss of other coverage) that triggers eligibility for mid-year benefits enrollment changes or COBRA coverage.
An employee exempt from overtime provisions of the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), typically salaried.
An employee entitled to overtime pay under the FLSA, typically hourly.
The first 90 calendar days of employment for staff, or the first academic year for faculty.
The direct supervisor listed in employee_roster.xlsx for a given employee.
The first 30 calendar days from an employee's start date during which the employee must enroll in or waive benefits.
All employee internal email addresses follow the format [first initial].[last name]@crestwood.edu (e.g., John Smith = j.smith@crestwood.edu).
All times in this document are Mountain Standard Time (MST, UTC-7) or Mountain Daylight Time (MDT, UTC-6).

policy_questions.question: The HR Coordinator is said to work with email, Slack, calendar, Jira, spreadsheets and document templates. Is this a full grant list, so that the coordinator may never use the store tools (shopify__update_cart, shopify__create_order)?
General Inquiries has no row in the Jira naming table. Does a general inquiry get a Jira ticket, and if yes with which prefix, assignee and date?

Steps 3 and 4 of triage say to take no further action for employee relations and payroll requests, but the naming table has ER and BENEFITS rows. Does the coordinator create a Jira ticket in these two cases?
The Benefits & Payroll row says "Calvin Briggs / Patricia Huang". Which requests go to each person?

Benefits changes, qualifying life events, employment verifications, policy questions and form requests have no procedure section. Are they handled by Step 7 of triage in some way, or escalated as not covered with [OUT OF SCOPE]?
A complaint that also mentions an attorney matches both triage Step 3 (forward to m.voss@crestwood.edu, reply using Template 2) and Section 16 (do NOT reply). Which one wins?

Section 16 says to escalate to the HR Director but names a channel and a format only for legal threats and media inquiries. How is a P1 issue or a case older than 10 business days escalated: a post to #hr-escalations, an email, or both?
Which Slack channel takes the [OUT OF SCOPE] notification? The text does not name one.
The default subject starts with [Template Name]. What is the subject of a new email that uses no template, such as a follow-up to the hiring manager or an email to d.okonkwo@crestwood.edu?

Some templates have two names, for example Template 4 "New Hire Welcome" and "Welcome Email", Template 9 "Benefits Final Notice (Day 25)" and "Final Benefits Notice", Template 19 "ADA Accommodation Request Acknowledged" and "ADA Request Acknowledged", Templates 8, 24, 25 and 26 with and without the part in brackets, Template 23 with and without "Annual". Which name goes in the subject line?

Must every Jira comment use the default comment format with one of the listed Actions, including "No COBRA required – employee not enrolled in health benefits." and the new information added under triage Step 5?

The description table adds Priority, Deadline and Status when a section involves a deadline or tells you to assign a priority, but no section says to assign a priority. Which sections count, and what is the value of Status?

I-9 "Day 2" and "Day 3": is Day 1 the first day of work, and are these business days? Section 2 is due "within 3 business days of the employee's first day of work" and Day 3 "is the federal deadline".

Steps send to the hiring manager, but Template 4 says "Your supervisor" conducts the orientation and Template 7 is addressed to the supervisor. Is the hiring manager the supervisor of record? employee_roster.xlsx has no hiring manager field.
Template 4 says "see acceptable documents list attached", but no file with that list is named in Section 6. Which file is attached?
Template 11 needs a [Coverage End Date], and no section says how to find it. Which date is it? And who mails the COBRA election form "within 5 business days"?

End of contract is a separation type in Section 12, but final pay and access revocation name only voluntary, involuntary and retirement. What timing and which Template 12 and 13 wording apply to end of contract, and which final pay timing applies to retirement?
Is a retirement or an end of contract a "voluntarily separating" case that gets the Template 14 exit interview invitation, and from which notice do the 2 business days count?
Signed forms are to be saved or filed "as a PDF" and "in the employee's file". Which folder or system is that? No location is named.

"Use email only, and limit recipients to Patricia Huang and Nicole Ashford": does this limit apply only to discussing the disability or accommodation, given that Step 3 sends Template 19 to the employee?
"mailing the candidate the background check authorization form": is this physical mail, or email with the PDF? Section 6 says only "sent to candidate".
Template 29 needs an [RSVP Date], and no section says how far ahead it is. Which date is it?
A forwarded-only email that is P1 or P2 (for example a formal complaint): does it stay in the Inbox with a flag, or move to "General"?
A resolved P1 or P2 email moves to "the appropriate topic folder", but the General folder is for "anything already resolved". Which folder takes a resolved case?
A request can arrive by Slack. If it arrives as a direct message, may the coordinator answer it by direct message, given "Do not use direct messages for case-related communication"?
